event_summary: A blue crystalline-looking rod is shown near a black nozzle emitting a small blue flame while their visible alignment changes slightly over time.
raw_event_description: The clip opens with an irregular translucent blue crystalline-looking rod angled diagonally on the left and a black cylindrical nozzle on the right emitting a narrow blue flame toward the rod. Across the sequence, the rod remains close to the flame, with the flame tip repeatedly appearing near different spots along the upper half of the rod. The flame stays visible throughout, sometimes showing a purple-blue outer region. The rod remains visibly continuous and crystalline-looking, with sparkly highlights and small greenish patches near its upper end. Focus and framing vary slightly, and the nozzle and flame become briefly blurrier in some later moments.

reasons: The blue crystalline-looking rod and the black nozzle with flame are already visible at the start.
The support or holder for the rod is not visible.
Only part of the nozzle is visible at the right edge.
